business.description: Saurashtra Cement Limited operates in cement and paints divisions. The company manufactures cement at Ranavav and Sidheegram units in Gujarat and sells paints under the Snowcem brand.

products.name: Cement
products.note: Revenue increased by about 8 percent despite lower price realizations, on account of higher sales volume. Completed cement grinding modernisation project at Sidheegram resulting in higher grinding and blending capacity and consequently higher cement production capability.

products.name: Paints
products.note: Revenue was about 12 percent higher than previous year. Widened market reach by appointment of new dealers resulting in higher sales volume and better product mix. Industry witnessed intense competition resulting in low realizations.
